name: Fresh
summary: A terminal text editor with familiar keybindings, mouse support, LSP features, multi-cursor editing and git worktree multitasking.
use_cases: edit multi-gigabyte files in the terminal
run coding agents in separate git worktrees
features: command palette and fuzzy file finder
multitask across git worktrees with Orchestrator

setup.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/fr && cd /tmp/fr && git init -q . 2>/dev/null; printf 'foo bar\nfoo baz\nfoo qux\n' > /tmp/fr/sample.txt && cat > /tmp/fr/drive.py <<'EOF'
import os, pty, sys, time, re, select, struct, fcntl, termios
# usage: drive.py file key1 key2 ... ; keys are python-escaped strings, sent with delay
args = sys.argv[1:]
f = args[0]; keys = [k.encode().decode('unicode_escape') for k in args[1:]]
pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.environ['TERM'] = 'xterm-256color'
    os.chdir('/tmp/fr')
    os.execvp('fresh', ['fresh', '--no-upgrade-check', f])
fcntl.ioctl(fd, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', 30, 100, 0, 0))
buf = b''
def drain(t):
    global buf
    end = time.time() + t
    while time.time() < end:
        r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.1)
        if r:
            try: buf += os.read(fd, 65536)
            except OSError: return
drain(3)
for k in keys:
    os.write(fd, k.encode()); drain(1.5)
mark = len(buf)
drain(1)
text = buf.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
plain = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]|\x1b\][^\x07]*\x07|\x1b[()][A-Z0-9]|\x1b[=>]', ' ', text)
print(re.sub(r' {2,}', ' ', plain))
try:
    os.write(fd, b'\x11'); drain(1)
    os.kill(pid, 9)
except Exception: pass
EOF

pitfalls.readme_said: Features are shown as interactive GIF demos only
pitfalls.actually_needed: Fresh is a full-screen TUI; the checks drove it through a Python pty script that sends keystrokes (Ctrl+P, Ctrl+D, Alt+Enter) and prints the screen text

pitfalls.readme_said: Start each task in its own worktree
pitfalls.actually_needed: Orchestrator needs a git repo with at least one commit and an agent picked in the New Workspace dialog (the 'terminal' agent works with no account)

judge.observed: The command palette opens and shows the 'file | >command | :line | #buffer' hint with the Select Theme entry, the multi-cursor edit saves 'ZZ bar/ZZ baz/ZZ qux', and the version check prints 'fresh 0.5.9'.
